# GovCon Opportunity Feed — GovCon Opportunity Feed — SAM.gov + Grants.gov fused, with incumbents and change alerts

> Every matching federal contract and grant opportunity across SAM.gov and Grants.gov, deduplicated, agency-normalized, with who won similar work and what changed since your last run. No SAM.gov key required.

## Use it
- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/publicrecords~govcon-opportunity-feed/runs
